title: Enterprise Identity & Access Control (RBAC/ABAC)
summary: Implement zero-trust identity, fine-grained RBAC/ABAC permissions, and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security tenant isolation.

problem.headline: Cross-Tenant Leaks & Weak Permission Guards
points: Boolean role flags failing to support enterprise permissions and org hierarchies.
Catastrophic cross-tenant data leak risks in shared database clusters.
Session hijacking vulnerabilities and unmanaged JWT token expiration.

approach.headline: Database-Level RLS & Fine-Grained Permission Matrices
points: Enforce PostgreSQL Row-Level Security policies to isolate multi-tenant data at the engine level.
Replace broad roles with explicit permission strings evaluated by type-safe middleware.
Deploy HTTP-only cookie session rotation with token breach detection.

deliverables: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security schema migration & tenant functions
Secure cookie session rotation & revocation system
